claims.text: ARF: 10-day course of PO penicillin, or one IM penicillin G benzathine inj, to eradicate lingering organisms.
claims.quote: a 10-day course of oral penicillin or amoxicillin, or a single injection of penicillin G benzathine, is used to eradicate any lingering organisms and prevent reinfection

claims.text: Then prophylaxis: penicillin G benzathine IM q3–4 wk
claims.quote: The standard regimen for prophylaxis against recurrent GAS infection is penicillin G benzathine IM every 3 to 4 weeks.
In parts of the world with high ARF endemicity, IM prophylaxis every 3 weeks is superior to every 4 weeks.
